images.title: Cutting the letter M from folded paper
images.purpose: Show the worked example: a paper folded in half along a vertical line with half of the letter M drawn along the fold, and the opened paper with the full M.
images.composition: Two panels side by side, the folded paper on the left, the opened paper on the right, a small arrow between them.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two panels side by side. LEFT PANEL: a rounded rectangle 480 wide and 450 tall (x 120 to 600, y 180 to 630) with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill. In it a tall amber #E69F00 rectangle 150 wide and 300 tall (x 285 to 435, y 255 to 555) is the paper folded in half; its folded edge is the right side, drawn as a thicker 6 px dark line. On the paper the left half of a capital letter M is drawn as a teal #0072B2 outline 6 px thick: one tall stroke down the left side of the paper and one slanting stroke from the top of that stroke down to the folded edge, its lowest point on the folded edge about two thirds of the way down. RIGHT PANEL: a rounded rectangle 480 wide and 450 tall (x 856 to 1336, y 180 to 630) with a thin dark outline and a white fill. In it an amber square 300 by 300 px (x 946 to 1246, y 255 to 555) is the opened paper, with the full capital letter M in teal #0072B2, about 230 px wide and 230 px tall, filling the middle of the square and exactly symmetrical about a dashed vertical line in grey #6B7280 (4 px dashes) at x 1096, running from y 235 to y 575. Between the panels, one arrow pointing right in reddish purple #CC79A7 at y 405 (x 640 to 816). Under the left panel, centred at x 360 and y 690, the caption Folded paper; under the right panel, centred at x 1096 and y 690, the caption Opened paper, both in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px). Exactly 2 panels, 1 arrow and 2 captions. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a letter M whose two halves differ
a horizontal fold line on the M
images.takeaway: Half of the M drawn along the fold makes the whole M when the paper is opened.
images.description: A folded paper with the left half of the letter M drawn along the fold, an arrow, and the opened paper with the full M and a dashed line of symmetry.
images.context: Concept image for the first teaching concept, Fold on a Line of Symmetry. It uses the plan's own letter M (a practice value), not the letters of the book's questions.
images.teaching_notes: Point at the dashed line: it is the line of symmetry and it is where the paper was folded. The slip to watch: folding along a line where the two halves of the letter do not match.

image_decisions.why: The folded and opened paper with the plan's own letter M make the worked example visible: half drawn along the fold becomes the whole letter.
